Special Assignment: Lynx Rescue is a Special Assignment world quest that takes place at the Sanguine Grasps in Hallowfall.

Special Assignments (or capstone world quests) are a type of world quest that provides Pinnacle cache, with one-two being available each week. These world quests are locked and require completing at least 3 other world quests in the given zone to unlock them. They can be identified with a banner underneath them while locked and when available .

__NOTOC__ The Specular Rainbowfish is an fish from . They are most commonly caught in Glimmerpools, but they can also be fished up from open water; they are generally native to the seas surrounding the Isle of Dorn, though they can be caught in the subterranean regions as well. These fish are not used directly in any Cooking recipes; instead, chefs carve them into fresh fillets for use in other recipes.

Spirit of Cooperation is a delve buff applied for killing a mob that had slayed an adventurer (aka a player). These normal mobs will have a "red aura" on them and may have a title, with the name and realm being the player it killed. It lasts for 10 minutes, persists through death, and will persist outside of the delve. However, it will be removed upon entering an arena, Mythic+ run, or a raid.
